《 医学英语阅读 》 是根据教育部大学英语教学改革的要求 ， 并结合大学英语教学改革的实际情况而编写的 。 主要供完成了大学英语基础阶段的学习进入高级阶段的本科医学专业的学生使用 。
教材选材真实多样 ， 以单元主题的形式 ， 并以 “ 医生一病人一健康 ” 为主线 ， 让学生从不同的角度 、 不同的层面认识和了解当代医学发展的现状与未来 。 本教材由 10 个单元组成 ， 每个单元包括同一主题的两篇文章 。 选材内容覆盖现代医学广泛的话题 ， 具有很强的针对性 ， 合理兼顾医学基础知识和语言两者 ， 从而使教材具有主题教材的时代气息 ， 同时也提供了语言学习的丰富内容 。 本教材在体例上有以下特点 ：
每个单元中的 partl 为课前练习 ， 要求学生在正式学习前查阅相关背景资料 ， 主要涉及该单元的一些专用术语 、 相关医学组织机构介绍 、 疾病和治疗相关知识介绍等 ， 促使学生积极主动地学习 ， 接触更多的相关医学英语文献 。 课前准备的任务将在课堂上由教师有序地 、 有机地融入互动的课堂教学中 ， 旨在增强学生课堂学习的能动性 。
根据医学英语词汇特点 ， 安排了构词基础知识 ， 让学生对医学词汇结构体系有初步的整体认识 ， 为学生过渡到高年级的双语教学和专业医学英语学习打好基础 。
每个单元设计了 Practical Skill.s 部分 ， 以简明 、 易学 、 实用为出发点 ， 重在操练学生的实用写作技能 。 此部分主要介绍医学论文英文摘要 、 医学病例 、 医学原始报告等的格式要求 ，
真正体现本课程的实用性 。
本书的练习安排突出对学生读 、 写 、 译技能培养的要求 ， 设有词汇运用 、 阅读理解 、 英汉互译等练习项目 。 每个练习紧扣课文 ， 既是对课文从内容到形式的复习 ， 又是课文内容的有机延伸 。
书后附有练习答案 ， 为教师实施教学创造条件 ， 同时又适合学生自学 。
本书在编写过程中 ， 虽然编者倾注了大量的精力 ， 但仍可能有不足和纰漏 ， 使用者的任何建议和批评都会是编者今后改进的动力 。 在编写过程中编者得到了领导和同行大量的支持和帮助 ， 更得到了出版社编辑的大力协助 ， 编者在此表示诚挚的谢意 。

A summary ， synopsis, or recap is a shorter version Of the original. Such a simplification
highlights the major points from the much longer subject ， such as a text ， speech ， film ， or event.
The purpose is tO help the audience get the g1St in a short periOd Of time.
A written summary starts with a lead ， including title ， author ， text type ， and the main idea Of
the text. lt has a clearly arranged structure and is paraphrased with new words without quotations
from the text.
Unlike a retelling ， a summary has no dramatic Structure and iS written in present tense
or historical present. ln summaries only indirect speech is used and depictions are avoided.
Summaries Of books or dissettations present the major facts in scientific language.
Nonfiction summaries serve tO familiarize the reader with the subJect matter Of an entire
work in a short space Of time. They are written in a balanced and objective way ， mirroring
the genre ， s aim tO portray actual events from the author ， s point Of view. Generally ， nonfiction
summaries dO not Offer analysis or assessment.
Summarizers use nonfiction guidelines mentioned above ， but alSO provide numerical ratings
and evaluations Of the titles covered. Shorter ， more concise nonfiction summaries are called
abstracts. The length Of a summary differs according tO the requirements.

The function Of the abstract Of scientific papers

The function Of the abstract Of scientific papers is tO provide an overview Of the paper SO
that the readers know the main story and a few essential details of the paper without reading
the whole text Of the paper. The abstract is extracted from the whole text with 3 characteristics ，
namely, shon ， fine and complete. The abstract should make sense bOth read alone and read with
the paper.
The classification of the abstract
The abstract iS divided intO indicative and informative abstract.
lndicative abstract: tO report the theme Of the paper ， not 怖 introduce the research materials ，
methods and results ， generally expressed with simple present tense. ln many professional
magazines ， there is an indicative abstract under the heading on the directory page. eg. Free
transfer Of tWO undamaged fingers from a replantable left arm tO a mutilated right hand of a
3-year-old boy is reported.
lnformative abstract: tO tell the readers the general situation Of the research ， and let
them know the purpose ， material, method ， result ， conclusion and problems in existence. The
informative abstract is divided into non-structured and structured. Since American Annals Of
lntemational Medicine adopted the structured abstract in medical papers for the first time in 1987 ，
many famous intemational medical journals followed.
The structured abstract includes the following basic elements:
* Objective/Purpose/Aim
* Methods
* Results
* Conclusion
Language features Of the structured abstract
* the frequent use Of past tense and passive voice
* the use of infinitive to express the research purpose
* the use Of noun phrase as the title ， including noun +prepositional phrase (e.g. Of ， in)

A research proposal is a document written that provides a detailed description Of the
proposed program. lt iS like an outline Of the entire research process that gives a reader a
summary Of the information discussed in a project.
Research proposals are written for various reasons ， such as budget request for the research

The phrasing Of research proposals has many similarities tO that Of scientific articles 、
* Research proposals are written in future tense and have different points Of emphasis.
* Research proposals have sections describing the research background ， significance ，
methods ， and references.
* The method section Of research proposals is far more detailed than those Of scientific
articles ， allowing profound understanding Of the price and risks Of the study and the plans for
reducing them.
* Research proposals have a section describing the hypotheses or the expected results.
* A typical research proposal includes an extensive but focused literature review.
* A research proposal may alSO include preliminary results.
* Research proposals usually contain the curriculum vitaes Of the researchers.
Research sponsors publish calls for research proposals ， specifying the topics intO which
they fttnd research and their detailed format requirements. Those sponsors may be governmental,
nonprofit or business research foundations.
